name: missing-return
query: USE kb FROM NODES Document AS d;

name: unclosed-string
query: USE kb FROM NODES Document AS d |> FILTER d.language = "th |> RETURN d.id;

name: unbounded-expand
query: USE kb FROM NODES Document AS d |> EXPAND d -[:REFERENCES*]->(x) |> RETURN x.id;

name: two-queries-in-one-request
query: USE kb FROM NODES Document AS d |> RETURN d.id; USE kb FROM NODES Document AS e |> RETURN e.id;

name: missing-knn-vector
query: USE kb FROM NODES Document AS d |> KNN d IN docs USING TOP 10 EXACT AS hit |> RETURN d.id;
